adjudication.rationale: In `parseRefreshTokenResponse`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` it uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(response)` instead of the passed `schema` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`). Zod objects strip unknown keys by default, so fields like `instance_url`, `id`, `issued_at`, `scope`, etc. from Salesforce’s real token response would be dropped from `accessTokenParsed.data`. In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the DB update persists `{ ...accessTokenParsed.data, refresh_token: ... }`, so later loads of the credential would indeed lack `instance_url`, causing a future jsforce connection to potentially be created without an instance URL.
